name: Shield AI
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
ledes: Shield AI is a privately held defense technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a Series H round announced on November 5, 2026, valued the company at $28.8 billion.

Founded in San Diego in 2015, Shield AI develops Hivemind, autonomy software that enables military aircraft to operate without a pilot, and the V-BAT unmanned aircraft. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Shield AI
table_note: Valuations are post-money. Amounts raised reflect equity only.
round_notes: The Series H formed part of a $2.5 billion financing that also included a $1 billion structured equity investment from funds managed by Blackstone and $500 million of debt. Shield AI has said the proceeds will principally fund its acquisition of the radar manufacturer Echodyne, a transaction valued at up to $5.3 billion that is expected to close in early 2027.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price. The terms of the Blackstone investment have not been disclosed, and a prospective buyer should establish how it ranks relative to the shares being offered.
investors: The Series H was co-led by Disruptive and Innovation X Capital. The Series G was co-led by Advent International and JPMorganChase. Investors in earlier rounds include Andreessen Horowitz, the U.S. Innovative Technology Fund, Riot Ventures, L3Harris Technologies and Hanwha.
spv_sentence: Since 2022, 24 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Shield AI have filed with the SEC, half of them in 2026.
funds: One SEC-registered fund reports a position in Shield AI. As of July 31, 2026, ARK Venture Fund held 143,760 shares, which it valued at $22.1 million, or $153.68 per share.
sources: Sources: Shield AI announcements dated November 5, 2026 and March 6, 2025; TechCrunch reports dated March 26, 2026, December 29, 2023 and October 31, 2023; SEC Form D filings; and ARK Venture Fund's Form N-PORT for the period ended July 31, 2026.
